items.title: Indian soldiers win first World Rowing Cup gold
items.summary: Indian soldiers Havildars Lakshay and Ujjwal Kumar Singh won India’s first gold medal at a World Rowing Cup on 27 June 2026.

items.title: IAF Concludes Fifth Warfare and Aerospace Strategy Programme
items.summary: The Indian Air Force concluded the fifth Warfare & Aerospace Strategy Programme (WASP) with a Capstone Seminar on 29 June 2026 in New Delhi.

items.title: General Dhiraj Seth Takes Charge as Chief of Army Staff
items.summary: General Dhiraj Seth assumed charge as the 31st Chief of the Army Staff on 30 June 2026.
items.numbers: He served as the 49th Vice Chief of the Army Staff from 1 April 2026 before taking over as COAS.

items.title: Rajnath Singh Launches DFP-2026 for DRDO
items.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh released the Delegation of Financial Powers to DRDO (DFP-2026) in New Delhi on 29 June 2026.
items.numbers: DFP-2026 is a financial and administrative framework for the Defence Research and Development Organisation.

items.title: Project BRAHMANK Marks 16th Raising Day
items.summary: Project BRAHMANK is a Border Roads Organisation project in Arunachal Pradesh that was formally commissioned in December 2011.
items.numbers: During FY 2025-26, the project completed 13 bridges with a combined span of 390 metres across the Siang and Siyom Valleys.

items.title: Gram Sabha Participation Study
items.summary: A National Study Report titled Low Participation in Gram Sabha across States and Union Territories is scheduled for release on 30 June 2026 in New Delhi.

items.title: Global Skills Challenge 2026 India Wins Five Medals
items.summary: India won five medals at the Global Skills Challenge Australia 2026, which was held from 23 June to 29 June 2026.
items.numbers: The medal tally included three gold, one silver, and one bronze, and the event served as a preparatory competition for the 48th WorldSkills Competition in Shanghai later in 2026.

items.title: Ayushman Sarathi PM-JAY Chatbot Launched
items.summary: Ayushman Sarathi PM-JAY Chatbot was launched on 29 June 2026 in New Delhi by Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda.

items.title: Van Mahotsav Tree Plantation Campaign
items.summary: Van Mahotsav is India’s annual week-long tree plantation festival observed from 1 July to 7 July. The campaign began in 1950 under K.M.
items.numbers: On 1 July 2026, the 77th Van Mahotsav began in several districts of Manipur, where the Forest Department set a target of about 15 lakh saplings under the Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 3.0 initiative.

items.title: Kodaikanal Solar Observatory AI Study
items.summary: Researchers used artificial intelligence to analyse more than a century of hand-drawn solar observations from the Kodaikanal Solar Observatory in Tamil Nadu.
items.numbers: The study used digitised solar charts from 1904 to 2022 and created a long continuous record of solar magnetic activity.

items.summary: SHE-LEAPS, or Self-Help Entrepreneur-Livelihoods and Enterprise Application for Prosperity and Sustainability, is a digital platform launched on 29 June 2026 for women…

items.title: Interplanetary Coronal Mass Ejections Thermal Evolution
items.summary: Interplanetary Coronal Mass Ejections (ICMEs) are large solar eruptions that travel from the Sun to Earth and interact with the solar wind and the geomagnetic field.
items.numbers: The findings were published in Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society by 1 July 2026.

items.title: UIDAI Enables Aadhaar Email Update Through App
items.summary: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) enabled residents to add or update email IDs in Aadhaar through the Aadhaar mobile application on 1 July 2026.
items.numbers: More than 2.5 lakh email updates were recorded in the first two days of the service, from 1 July to 2 July 2026.

items.title: Daily Current Affairs Quiz: July 4, 2026

items.title: Japan Backs Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Target
items.summary: Japan has reaffirmed cooperation for India to begin commercial operations on priority sections of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail project by 2027.
items.numbers: Japan is financing 81% of the project cost of about US$17 billion through a 50-year loan at 0.1% interest.

items.title: Indian Navy Deploys P-8I for RIMPAC 2026
items.summary: The Indian Navy has deployed a P-8I long-range maritime reconnaissance and anti-submarine warfare aircraft to Hawaii for the Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) 2026 exercise.
items.numbers: RIMPAC 2026 is the 30th edition of the biennial naval exercise and is being held at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam from June 24, 2026, to July 31, 2026.

items.title: Canada Cuts Super Visa Processing Time for Indians
items.summary: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada reduced the Super Visa processing time for Indian applicants to 50 days as of 3 July 2026.
items.numbers: Study permit processing for Indian applicants increased to 5 weeks as of 2 July 2026.

items.title: India Signs First Global Green Methanol Supply Deal
items.summary: ACME Green Molecules Business, part of India’s ACME Group, signed a binding long-term Purchase and Sale Agreement with Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company on 3 July 2026.

items.title: What is the One Health Approach?

items.title: Drugs Rules Amended for Cell and Gene Therapies
items.summary: The Government of India amended the Drugs Rules, 1945, on 2 July 2026 through the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
items.numbers: The Drugs Rules, 1945, were framed under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, which regulates the import, manufacture, distribution, and sale of drugs in India.

items.title: Indian scientists develop placenta-on-chip platform
items.summary: Indian researchers from Mumbai have developed a lab-grown placenta-on-chip platform that recreates key placental functions.

items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Modified UDAN scheme for a ten-year period from FY 2026-27 to FY 2035-36 with a total outlay of Rs. 28,840 crore.
